main_question: Across all 12 previously published and frozen original Movebank GPS studies, what signs and source-study-equal descriptive temporal q/astronomical daylength associations remain when four new multi-native studies and all source coverage failures are preserved?
source_frame: 8 existing original DOI and 12 native study-taxon records plus 4 independent pre-event source-only frozen DOI and 10 native records; 12 DOIs and 22 native study-taxon records, 20 unique native taxon labels. No duplicate DOI.
q: Same original hourly-bin selected 0.5–2h GPS step velocity q=mean per source tagged animal of log1p(median NIGHT step km/h) minus log1p(median DAY step km/h), not activity duration. n>=5 for tagged bootstrap.
photoperiod: Original native within-animal-year q~native GPS local astronomical daylength per hour. Keep this separate from goose shared-120-day study-reference daylength.
unit: One published DOI is one study; equal native taxon means within each DOI, then equal available DOI means. No weighting by fixes, tagged individuals or number of native taxa. Never make missing effect zero.
uncertainty: 5000 fixed-seed resamples of source DOI means and leave-one-DOI-out ranges, descriptive only conditional on purposive nonprobability source samples. Keep original tagged-bootstrap intervals as original; no fake global inference.
old_v_new: Preserve 7/8 eligible source q and 11 cohort results; compare expanded 9/12 eligible source q and 15 cohort results. Distinct source set, NOT time trend.
hold_policy: All 12 DOIs and 22 native rows retained including Great Egret size HOLD, Galapagos tortoise source taxonomy/schema HOLD, African vultures cadence HOLD, Anas acuta no q support. Never call those ecological zero.
goose: One new original goose DOI has three species on exactly 120 source-shared calendar days in 5 year-month blocks. Archive all three paired q and shared-reference photoperiod slopes separately from full source native q/daylength, never as independent studies.
privacy: Never publish original animal IDs, GPS coordinates, exact event timestamps, calendar dates, source private grid, individual-level effects or tracks. Public original DOI/taxon/group estimates and source support only.
interpretation: Post-result source-equal study sensitivity, not a probability sample of world ecological processes, taxon/guild causal contrast or independent prospective biological replication.
